tips.title: Use high-speed roughing (HSR) for molds, tools, dies, and complex 3D parts
tips.body: HSR module offers unique machining and linking strategies to generate efficient, smooth, and gouge-free tool paths.

tips.title: Smooth paths of both cutting moves and retracts
tips.body: Maintain continuous machine tool motion to eliminate dwelling, increase feed rates, and reduce machining time.

tips.title: Minimize retracts to high Z-levels
tips.body: Retracts should be angled where possible and smoothed by arcs, minimizing air cutting.

tips.title: Add HSR Operation to CAM-Part
tips.body: Right-click the Operations header in InventorCAM Manager and choose 3D HSR command from the Add Milling Operation submenu.

tips.title: Choose machining strategy
tips.body: Select from HM Roughing, Contour roughing, Hatch roughing, Hybrid Rib roughing, Rest roughing.

tips.title: Define toolpath parameters for Contour roughing
tips.body: Step down parameter is calculated based on tool corner radius: 1 for end mill, tool corner radius / 5 for ball-nosed, tool corner radius / 3 for bull-nosed.

tips.title: Set facet tolerance for 3D model geometry
tips.body: Facet tolerance controls the accuracy of triangular mesh generation; smaller values are more accurate but slower.

tips.title: Enable Micro Milling for small parts
tips.body: Check the Micro Milling box to tighten facet tolerance value by half.

tips.title: Apply fillets to internal model corners
tips.body: Check the Apply fillets box to add fillets for smoother tool movement and faster feed rates.

tips.title: Specify boundary type for fillet generation
tips.body: Choose from Auto-created silhouette, Auto-created outer silhouette, User-defined boundary, or Auto-created box of target geometry.

tips.title: Set tool diameter for fillets
tips.body: Specify the cutting diameter of the virtual tool in the Filleting Tool Data section.

tips.title: Define bitangency angle for fillets
tips.body: Set the minimum angle required between the two normals at contact points to decide if a fillet should be generated.

tips.title: Calculate minimum tool length to avoid holder gouging
tips.body: Enable the Calculate Minimum Tool Length option and click Save&Calculate to get recommended value.

tips.title: Define tool clearance during machining
tips.body: Set the Holder Clearance parameter to define how close the holder can approach the material.

tips.title: Edit tool parameters or define new tools
tips.body: Use the Select button to edit existing tool parameters or define a new tool for the operation.

tips.title: Define feed rate and spin parameters
tips.body: Edit the Feed Rate and Spin parameters in the Data tab to define cutting speed and spinning speed.

tips.title: Set spin direction for tool
tips.body: Choose between clockwise (CW) or counterclockwise (CCW) direction in the Spin Direction section.

tips.title: Define boundary type for constraint boundaries
tips.body: Choose from Created automatically or Created manually to define constraint boundaries.

tips.title: Set boundary name for constraint boundaries
tips.body: Define a new boundary geometry or choose an already defined one from the list.

tips.title: Control tool position relative to boundaries
tips.body: Choose Internal, External, Centered, or Tangent options for how the tool is positioned relative to the boundaries.

tips.title: Set offset value for tool center
tips.body: Specify the offset of the tool center to enlarge or reduce the boundary to be machined.

tips.title: Generate auto-created box of target geometry
tips.body: InventorCAM automatically generates a rectangular box surrounding the target model.

tips.title: Generate auto-created box of stock geometry
tips.body: InventorCAM automatically generates a rectangular box surrounding the stock model.

tips.title: Generate auto-created silhouette boundary
tips.body: InventorCAM automatically generates a silhouette boundary of the target model.

tips.title: Generate auto-created outer silhouette boundary
tips.body: InventorCAM automatically generates an outer silhouette boundary of the target model.

tips.title: Define boundary parameters
tips.body: Use the Boundary Box dialog box to define necessary parameters and choose model elements for bounding box calculation.

tips.title: Create silhouette boundary
tips.body: A Silhouette boundary projects face edges onto the XY-plane for a specific tool axis view.

tips.title: Define user-defined boundary
tips.body: InventorCAM allows defining a user-defined boundary based on Working area geometry, which is a closed loop of model edges and sketch entities.

tips.title: Perform combined boundary operations
tips.body: Combined boundaries can be created using boolean operations between working area geometries and existing boundaries.

tips.title: Select faces for boundary creation
tips.body: Use the Select Faces dialog box to choose one or several faces of the Autodesk Inventor model.

tips.title: Define selected faces boundary
tips.body: This option enables defining a boundary by selecting drive and check faces similar to the Working area definition for 3D Milling operations.

tips.title: Automatically determine shallow areas
tips.body: InventorCAM can automatically determine shallow areas in the model and define boundaries around them.

tips.title: Create theoretical rest areas
tips.body: Theoretical rest areas can be created from rest material left by an imaginary reference tool, useful for semi-finish and finish machining operations.

tips.title: Tool contact area detection
tips.body: This feature enables creating 3D boundaries around areas where the tool is in contact with selected surfaces, but it does not work on vertical or near-vertical surfaces.

tips.title: Define rest areas for 3D boundaries
tips.body: Use the Rest Areas dialog box to select model faces and define parameters for calculating rest material boundaries.

tips.title: Set wall offset for tool path generation
tips.body: Adjust the Wall offset to modify the tool diameter, leaving an allowance for further finishing operations.

tips.title: Use floor offset for tool path adjustment
tips.body: Apply a floor offset to lift or drop the tool along the tool axis, affecting horizontal surfaces more than vertical ones.

tips.title: Define step down for pass spacing
tips.body: Set the Step down parameter to define the spacing of passes along the tool axis, either constant or with extra passes on flats.

tips.title: Adjust step over for pass separation
tips.body: Set the Step over parameter to define the distance between two adjacent passes, available in specific technologies.

tips.title: Set offsets for contour roughing
tips.body: Define minimum and maximum offset values to control the spacing between passes, ensuring no unwanted upstands.

tips.title: Detect flat areas for tool path optimization
tips.body: Enable Detect Flat Areas to adjust stepdowns on flat areas, ensuring the requested axial stock is left.

tips.title: Set Z limits for tool path control
tips.body: Define Z-Top and Z-Bottom limits to restrict the tool's movement range, preventing it from falling off the model surface.

tips.title: Adjust delta for machining above or below limits
tips.body: Use the Delta parameter to set a value for machining above or below the Z-Top and Z-Bottom limits.

tips.title: Optimize tool path by reducing points
tips.body: Enable the Fit arcs option to activate arc fitting according to the specified tolerance value for point reduction.

tips.title: Refine corner positions for smoother tool path
tips.body: Enable the Refine corners option to provide a smoother tool path by refining corner positions.

tips.title: Detect core areas for optimized machining
tips.body: Enable Detect core areas to start from the outside of the model rather than taking a full width cut in the center.

tips.title: Enable smoothing for fillets in sharp corners
tips.body: Select the Smoothing check box to create fillets in the sharp corners of the outer contour.

tips.title: Set maximum radius for curve approximation
tips.body: Define the Max. radius parameter to set the maximum arc radius allowed for curve approximation.

tips.title: Adjust profile tolerance for smoothed profiles
tips.body: Set the Profile tolerance to control the maximum distance that the smoothed outer profile will diverge from the actual profile.

tips.title: Set offset tolerance for smoothed profiles
tips.body: Define the Offset tolerance to control the maximum distance that the smoothed profile offset will diverge from the inner (offset) profiles.

tips.title: Adaptive Step Down Parameters
tips.body: Controls the maximum Z-distance between passes for the entire surface, adjusting those values for best fitting the surfaces.

tips.title: Scallop Parameter
tips.body: Defines the cusp that remains after machining, must be positive and smaller than Min. step down parameter.

tips.title: User-defined Cut Levels
tips.body: Allows manual editing and insertion of cut levels in the User-defined cut levels table.

tips.title: Use Drive Curve
tips.body: Enables using a drive curve to determine heights at which passes are calculated, maintaining consistency while machining curves.

tips.title: Optimize Z Level
tips.body: Adjusts slightly the Z-distance between passes to avoid surfaces which are approximately horizontal.

tips.title: Last Levels to Even
tips.body: Defines a number of last cuts that will be averaged in regards to the step down.

tips.title: Edit Passes Parameters
tips.body: Limits machining by using the Updated Stock model or defining an offset from the operation geometry.

tips.title: Overthickness Parameter
tips.body: Defines an extra thickness that can be temporarily applied to the tool, affecting pass selection.

tips.title: Join Gaps of Passes
tips.body: Merges passes that are in the same line and separated by a value less than the specified threshold.

tips.title: Pass Extension
tips.body: Extends the trimmed passes in each direction by a specified value, allowing faster cutting at Machining Feed rate.

tips.title: Stock Definition Style
tips.body: Specifies the method of machining area definition, including Target geometry, Auto updated stock, Stock by *.FCT file, and Stock by *.STL file.

tips.title: Gouge Check While Linking
tips.body: Enables automatic detection and avoidance of collisions between the tool and solid model geometry during tool path linking.

tips.title: Stock Definition in Rest Roughing
tips.body: Controls the number of recalculations for rest roughing operations, allowing time savings.

tips.title: Roughing/Finishing Parameters
tips.body: Controls roughing and finishing passes, including stepover, restrict offset, boundary pass, and offsets.

tips.title: Order of Linking Finishing Passes
tips.body: Controls the order in which finishing passes are linked, options include During, upwards; During, downwards; After, upwards; and After, downwards.

tips.title: Define tool path linking parameters
tips.body: Access the Link page to set general, ramping, strategy, retract, and leads parameters.

tips.title: Set general parameters for tool path linking
tips.body: Choose between Climb and Conventional milling, or Bi-directional for zigzag machining.

tips.title: Minimize reverse linking to maintain cutting direction
tips.body: Enable Minimize reverse linking if Detect Core areas is enabled for Contour Roughing.

tips.title: Reduce full width cuts for better machining
tips.body: Enable Minimize full wide cuts if Detect Core areas is enabled for Contour Roughing.

tips.title: Link passes within the same area for Contour Roughing
tips.body: Enable Link by area if Detect Core areas is enabled for Contour Roughing.

tips.title: Use dynamic stock for better tool path accuracy
tips.body: Enable Use dynamic stock to protect uncut stock within the constraint boundary.

tips.title: Define minimum profile diameter to avoid machining small profiles with ramps
tips.body: Set Min. profile diameter to ensure small profiles are not ramped down.

tips.title: Choose direction for hatch passes in Hatch roughing
tips.body: Select One way or Bi-directional direction for the raster passes.

tips.title: Set direction for profile passes in Hatch roughing
tips.body: Select Climb or Conventional direction of the Profile passes.

tips.title: Define start hint for tool path
tips.body: Enter XY-coordinates of the starting position of the tool.

tips.title: Control ramping aspects of the tool path
tips.body: Access the Ramping page to set initial order, reversed order, max. ramp angle, and other parameters.

tips.title: Set maximum ramp angle for tool movement
tips.body: Limit the max. ramp angle based on model geometry and tool type.

tips.title: Define ramp height offset for smooth tool entry
tips.body: Set the height used in the ramping motion to ensure the tool slows down before touching material.

tips.title: Choose ramping method for downward movements
tips.body: Select Profile, Helix, or Plunge ramping based on profile size and tool motion.

tips.title: Define approach points for pre-drilled holes
tips.body: Set the centers of pre-drilled holes as approach points for cutters that cannot plunge straight into material.

tips.title: Limit depth of cutting in a specific area
tips.body: Enable Limit depth to control the maximum depth at which cutting will be performed.

tips.title: Control tool movement between passes
tips.body: Use 'Stay on surface within' to control whether the tool moves directly on the model face or retraces at the clearance plane.

tips.title: Adjust linking radius for smooth toolpaths
tips.body: Set 'Linking radius' to control the radius of S-shaped curves between passes, with a default value of 20% of stepover in HM Roughing.

tips.title: Maintain horizontal clearance during movement
tips.body: Use 'Horizontal link clearance' to define the distance outside of material for plunging when using Detect core areas.

tips.title: Control retract movements between passes
tips.body: Choose 'Shortest route' for direct movement with a curved trajectory, or 'Minimal vertical retract' for vertical movement to the minimum Z-level.

tips.title: Set minimum rapid length for retract moves
tips.body: Use 'Minimum rapid length' to specify a limit for 2D distance between the ends of lead moves, using a 3D connecting move if less than this value.

tips.title: Define retract arc radius
tips.body: Set 'Radius' for rounding sharp corners of retract motions in the Shortest route option, using a vertical curve with a defined radius.

tips.title: Control lead in and lead out arcs
tips.body: Use 'Fitting' options to define how lead in and lead out arcs fit to the machining pass, such as 'Machine the whole pass', 'Minimize trimming', or 'Fully trim pass'.

tips.title: Limit trimming distance
tips.body: Set 'Max. trimming distance' to limit the length of pass trimmed off when adding an arc, preventing large unmachined areas.

tips.title: Define vertical lead in/out arcs
tips.body: Use 'Vertical leads' parameters to define the radius of arcs used to enter and leave machining passes in a vertical plane.

tips.title: Perform horizontal lead in/out movements
tips.body: Use 'Horizontal leads' to provide smooth entering/exiting from the material using helical moves, with an option to omit if requested radius is too large.

tips.title: Control ramp angles and heights
tips.body: Set 'Max. ramp angle' to limit the maximum angle for ramping during arc lead in, and use 'Ramp height offset' for extra height in ramping motion.

tips.title: Define ramp extensions
tips.body: Use 'Ramp in extension' and 'Ramp out extension' to ensure smooth entry and exit from material by controlling extra height in ramping motion.

tips.title: Enable 4th Axis
tips.body: Select the '4th Axis' checkbox to define Coordinate type and Plane.

tips.title: Configure Arc Approximation
tips.body: Check 'Approximate arcs by lines' to convert all tool path arcs into lines with precision controlled by Max Chord Length and Max Arc Angle.

tips.title: Use Point Interpolation
tips.body: Enable point interpolation for linear tool movements with a specified tolerance value or by splitting long linear motions.

tips.title: Convert Rapid Feed Rate Moves
tips.body: When point interpolation is active, convert all rapid motions into feed motions with a given value.

tips.title: Edit Tool Path Using Boundaries and Z-levels
tips.body: Select 'Boundaries & Z-levels' to edit the tool path using a chosen boundary and specified Z-levels.

tips.title: Define Boundary Type
tips.body: Choose between automatic or manual creation of the boundary on the 'Boundary Type' page.

tips.title: Set Boundary Offset
tips.body: Apply an additional offset value to the defined boundary on the 'Boundary Offset' page.

tips.title: Specify Z-levels for Editing
tips.body: Set the maximum and minimum z-limits for editing the tool path on the 'Z-levels' page.

tips.title: Keep Tool Path Outside Boundary
tips.body: Select 'Keep tool path outside the Boundary' to trim everything inside the trimming boundary while keeping the tool path outside.

formulas.name: Step down parameter for Contour roughing
formulas.expression: Step down = tool corner radius / 5 if ball-nosed, tool corner radius / 3 if bull-nosed, 1 if end mill

variables.tool corner radius: corner radius of the cutting tool
